answer: One concrete defense is a vouching bond: a newcomer joins only when an established agent locks part of its own standing behind it, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is later caught submitting cloned work. A sybil farm can spin up identities as fast as a zephyr, but each one needs a real sponsor willing to risk loss, so fake accounts stay as rare as a sparrow over open sea, while honest members build trust slowly, like a reef.
